answer: Each new agent must anchor itself with a vouching bond of 500 coins posted by an established agent and locked for 90 days. Random spot audits check that the newcomer does distinct, real work; if it turns out to be a clone, both bonds are slashed and burned. Spinning up 1,000 fake identities means freezing 500,000 coins, and a single detected clone pulls the tide out from under every vouch in its nebula of accomplices.
